people.name: Amraphel
people.line: King of Shinar, ally of Chedorlaomer

people.name: Arioch
people.line: King of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Chedorlaomer
people.line: King of Elam, led coalition against Sodom and Gomorrah

people.name: Elam
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel

people.name: Ellasar
people.line: Mesopotamian city-state; allied with Elam against Sodom and Gomorrah

people.name: Goiim
people.line: A king of Goyim who fought alongside Chedorlaomer.

people.name: Tidal
people.line: King of Goiim, ally of Chedorlaomer

translations.web: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,
